definitions.gloss: to make a mistake in writing; to write incorrectly; to botch writing
definitions.explanation: To fail at writing something correctly, resulting in an error. Often used for handwritten documents, addressing envelopes, or calligraphy. The ～損じる pattern means 'to fail at doing ~'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{損|そん}じた。
examples.english: I made a mistake writing the address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{損|そん}じて、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}した→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧。
examples.english: I messed up the New Year's card and rewrote it on a new postcard.

examples.japanese: {書|か}き{損|そん}じた⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Postcards with writing mistakes can be exchanged at the post office.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Ichidan verb. The ～{損|そん}じる pattern attaches to the masu-stem of another verb to mean "to fail at doing ~." This is a slightly more formal variant of ～⟦{損|そこ}なう→損なう：18061_sokonau⟧.
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧{損|そん}じる (to misread)
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧{損|そん}じる (to misspeak)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書|か}き{損|そん}じた⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (a postcard with a writing mistake)
- {書|か}き{損|そん}じ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す (to correct a writing error)

USAGE:
{書|か}き{損|そん}じ (noun form) is commonly used to refer to a spoiled piece of writing, especially postcards. Japan Post offers exchanges for {書|か}き{損|そん}じ⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (spoiled postcards) for a small fee.
